issue.title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?

summary.text: This is a documentation request to add Cloudflare Workers’ Flask deployment guide to Flask’s “Hosting Platforms” documentation. The discussion has progressed to a maintainer inviting the reporter to open a pull request and share the project’s donation link with Cloudflare; no response to that invitation is recorded yet.

known_facts.text: The reporter states that Cloudflare Workers supports deploying Flask applications and links to a short Cloudflare guide.
A maintainer initially noted that the linked examples repository lacked the referenced example; the reporter subsequently said it had been merged and was then present.

A maintainer expressed concern that adding company-specific hosting links can feel like advertising, while also saying Cloudflare is comparable in scale to platforms already listed. The maintainer separately pointed to the Pallets donation page without promising service in exchange.
The latest comment asks whether the reporter would open a pull request and pass the donation link along. The complete five-comment thread contains no later response.

missing_information: Whether the reporter is still willing to open the proposed documentation pull request and pass the donation link to Cloudflare.

label_recommendations.name: docs
label_recommendations.reason: The request specifically proposes adding a link to Flask’s hosting documentation, so the repository’s active “docs” label is directly relevant.

draft_reply: @hoodmane, just a gentle follow-up on David’s question above: are you still interested in taking this forward?
